mode_notes: Finish M4 fix round 2 (mcp-parley rename, no-npx launcher, mid-turn delivery), then review round 3 and the human's live test.
autonomous_decisions: [autonomous] 2026-11-07: GLM-5.3-Flash free and DeepSeek/MiMo free hit OpenCode's free usage limit mid-M2 (GLM resets in ~9.7 h). M2 continued in the same OpenCode session on opencode/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free, the free model that still answered, instead of waiting or paying. Reversible: all work is in git. (Re-added by Claude: the builder's state rewrite dropped it.)

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: The M4 plugin-loading fix is held until the round-1 reviewer finishes, so the reviewer reads a stable tree; then plugin loading and the review findings go to the builder as one fix.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: The M4 round-2 fixes proceed without waiting for the npm-name decision, because the fix (installed commands call this repo's CLI by absolute path, written at setup time) is name-independent. Only the published npm name (M12) stays a blocker for the human.

Name decided by the human (2026-11-07): the npm package and CLI command are `mcp-parley` (Claude advised against it as a word-swap of the unrelated `parley-mcp` package; the human chose it anyway). [autonomous] follow-ons: data dir becomes ~/.mcp-parley, plugin/marketplace names use mcp-parley, the repo folder and GitHub repo stay `parley-mcp` (renaming the GitHub repo is an outward action for the human).
summary: M4 fix round 2 (kiro-M4-fix2): applied review-round-2 (soft_fail 6/10). Renamed to mcp-parley (data dir ~/.mcp-parley, PARLEY_DB_PATH kept; .parley/rules.md and PARLEY_* env NOT renamed; repo/GitHub stay parley-mcp). No installed config runs npx: a launcher at ~/.mcp-parley/bin/mcp-parley runs this install by absolute path and every MCP entry/hook/monitor/fake config points at it; doctor verifies the command points at this install. PostToolUse/Stop no longer drain (additionalContext is unreliable) so the monitor is the sole mid-turn delivery path; test proves a mid-turn message still reaches Claude. setup/uninstall surface claude command failures. Monitor passes --session monitor-$$ so delivered_session is recorded and requeue works. readPluginState is strict. Monitor-registers-everywhere deviation recorded. Live-test steps 1 and 7 fixed (exact tsx setup command; viewer-free receipts check). pnpm check green, 30 files / 154 tests.
open_risks: blocker: GitHub Actions blocked by the account billing lock (human-only fix).
next_action: M4 fix round 2 complete; run review round 3 (independent reviewer reads the diff + wb verify verdict), then the human's live two-session test (PROGRESS.md 'fix round 2' steps) is M4's remaining (H) acceptance. Open follow-up for the human: decide whether to add `tsx` as a dev dependency (the launcher needs it until M12 produces a compiled bin.js) — NOT added silently. Blocker unchanged: GitHub Actions billing lock.
